Barbwood Talisman I

Also recorded as Barbwood Talisman

Druid · Level 1 · Alteration

Effect

Imbues your defensive target's party with a talisman that increases armor class by 12, hit points by 24 and grants a 2 point damage shield. Does not stack with Talisman of the Grove.

Ranks

RankLevelCostEffect
I 1 16 +12 AC, +24 HP, 3 pt damage shield
II 8 38 +36 AC, +72 HP, 10 pt damage shield
III 16 60 +60 AC, +120 HP, 17 pt damage shield
IV 24 Unknown +84 AC, +168 HP, 25 pt damage shield
V 32 Unknown +108 AC, +216 HP, 33 pt damage shield
VI 40 Unknown +132 AC, +264 HP, 42 pt damage shield
VII 48 Unknown +156 AC, +312 HP, 49 pt damage shield

As it was earlier

What guides written while Vanguard was running recorded for this ability. Kept beside the current figures rather than replacing them — the game was rebalanced across its life, so both are right for their own year.
